answer: In agent economies%2C sybil resistance can come from requiring each agent to solve a unique cryptographic puzzle tied to a physical hardware token before joining. The ivory tower of pure digital identities collapses when every participant must embed a prism-like optical signature from a dedicated device%2C creating a haven only for those who pay the hardware and computation costs%3B an attacker scaling thousands of fakes faces linear expenses in tokens and energy that quickly exceed any gain.
